{{Otheruses|Nuclear}}
[[Digger crawler]]s were powered by ancient steam-powered '''nuclear fusion''' engines. These reactor would fuse atoms together to produce energy. Some [[Reactor/Legends|reactor cores]] were powered by nuclear fusion.
